sources.snippet: Abstract Occamy-1.0 is a cost-efficient co-work agent model that achieves strong performance on complex multi-step tasks while maintaining broad agentic capabilities at lower cost.

sources.title: Occamy — Data That Evolves with the Model
sources.snippet: At the core of Occamy is Data RSI, a recursive self-evolution mechanism that connects data construction with model training. The Data Engine composes executable tasks from personas, tools, fixtures, skills, constraints, and graders. Generation and validation systems iteratively refine each task until it is solvable, executable, and reliably scored.
